title: Preparing / reconstituting panel of Translators for Translation work (Gujarati to English) for submitting before Hon'ble Supreme Court.
text:
KEY LINES:
willingness in writing latest by 21-02-2024 5:00 p.m., in the Office of the High Court
2021 passed by the Hon’ble Chairman, HCLSC on office note dated 12-10-2021.
Date :-14/02/2024 sd/-

FULL TEXT:
N O T I C E
In order to submit English Translation of matters to the Supreme Court Legal
Services Committee, HCLSC is going to prepare list of panel of Ld. Advocates for the
work of translation (from Gujarati to English). Hence, the undersigned is directed to
request all Ld. Panel Advocates, HCLSC as well as practicing Advocates in the
High Court of Gujarat, who have practiced in the High Court of Gujarat for 3 or
more than 3 years, are well conversant with the vernacular language & are
interested to do translation work, as may be assigned by the HCLSC, to submit their
willingness in writing latest by 21-02-2024 5:00 p.m., in the Office of the High Court
Legal Services Committee, 1st Floor, GSLSA Building, Gujarat High Court Campus,
Sola @ Ahmedabad.
Furthermore, I am directed to inform that, for maintaining transparency, Ld.
Advocates will have to appear for a formal test, as may be directed by the Competent
Authority.
The Translation charges will be paid on the lines of the Order dated 16-10-
2021 passed by the Hon’ble Chairman, HCLSC on office note dated 12-10-2021.
Date :-14/02/2024 sd/-
(B H Ghasura)
Secretary
High Court Legal Services Committee
Note : Forms for willingness be collected from the Office of High Court Legal
Services Committee.
